title: Mission Outcome v1
description: Flattened evaluation row for a single mission (session). One row per session. Derived from the workflow event stream. Designed for training/eval-grade behavioral analysis — joinable with tool_call_eval rows via session_id.

parent_session_id.description: Parent session if this was a delegated task.

agent_profile.description: Agent profile name (e.g. explore, build, review).

stop_reason.description: Reason the session ended, if available.

duration_ms.description: Total wall-clock session duration in milliseconds.

turn_count.description: Number of agent turns (steps) in the session.

tool_calls_total.description: Total tool calls made in the session.

tool_calls_refused.description: Tool calls with status=refused (guard or permission).

tool_names_used.description: Distinct tool names invoked during the session.

files_read_count.description: Distinct files read during the session (by path_hash).

files_changed_count.description: Distinct files created or modified (by path_hash).

files_modified_count.description: Files modified via write_file or search_replace.

dirty_files_before.description: Number of dirty files at mission start (from DirtyFileGuard).

protected_files_touched.description: Dirty files that were modified by the mission.

protected_files_skipped.description: Dirty files the mission skipped (did not touch).

write_refusals.description: Times the guard refused a write or search_replace.

expected_hash_matches.description: Times an expected_before_sha256 matched, allowing a protected write.

expected_hash_mismatches.description: Times an expected_before_sha256 did NOT match, blocking a protected write.

tests_passed.description: Number of test runs with exit_code=0.

tests_failed.description: Number of test runs with exit_code!=0.

human_interactions.description: Number of human followup interactions (questions, input, cancellations, ratings).

child_session_count.description: Number of child sessions delegated via task().

child_profiles_used.description: Distinct agent profiles used by child tasks.

delegation_parallelism.description: Execution parallelism strategy for child tasks.

delegation_conflicts.description: Number of reported conflicts between child tasks.

search_queries.description: Number of grep search queries executed.

search_results_clicked.description: Number of files read within 2 steps after a search result.

search_results_edited.description: Number of files edited within 2 steps after a search result.

context_chars_peak.description: Peak context size in characters during the session.

latency_total_ms.description: Sum of all tool call latencies in the session.

input_bytes_total.description: Sum of all tool input bytes.

output_bytes_total.description: Sum of all tool output bytes.

warnings_total.description: Total number of warning strings across all events.

repo_state_sha256.description: Final repository state SHA256 from GitStateArtifact.
